info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Dispute Details Retrieval API
info.description: The Dispute Details Retrieval API allows users to access specific information related to disputes using a unique dispute identifier. This endpoint serves financial institutions, customer service representatives, and claim handlers who need to investigate or manage disputes within transactions. Users can retrieve comprehensive details about a dispute's status, associated parties, and timestamps, aiding in efficient resolution and customer communication. Ideal for applications focused on transactions and customer service, this API enhances the transparency and management of financial disputes.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific dispute by its identifier.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific dispute using its unique identifier. You can use this operation to review the status, involved parties, and related documents associated with the dispute.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the details of a specific dispute identified by the reference code RES-100045. It expects the necessary parameters in JSON format.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the dispute details.

GetDisputeByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation in the Disputes API. It is a string type, likely containing a JSON representation of the request information.
